# dec.reconciler-registration: Reconcilers register with the scanner at startup

## Context

The scanner held a hard-coded list of the reconcilers it would run. Adding a
reconciler meant editing the engine, which put every new domain plugin through
a change to domain-agnostic code.

## Decision

Reconcilers register themselves with the scanner at startup through the
reconciler interface. The scanner runs whatever is registered, in registration
order, and knows nothing about any concrete implementation.

## Consequences

- A new reconciler ships without editing the scanner.
- Registration order becomes observable, so it is fixed by the registrar rather
  than by the engine.
- The scanner's tests register fakes instead of depending on a real reconciler.
